item.title: Show HN: Z80-μLM, a 'Conversational AI' That Fits in 40KB
item.description:
📝 With easy self-hosted distribution. Responds to greetings, questions about itself, and general banter with terse personality-driven answers. Features Trigram hash encoding: Input text is hashed into 128 buckets - typo-tolerant, word-order invariant 2-bit weight quantization: Each weight is {-2, -1, 0, +1}, packed 4 per byte 16-bit integer inference: All math uses Z80-native 16-bit signed arithmetic ~40KB.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/HarryR/z80ai
